messages:
Samira: FYI - we're getting multiple customer escalations over the last 18 hours about a noticeable drop in factual accuracy after yesterday's model rollout (region: eu-west). Customers describe confident but incorrect assertions (dates, company facts, product specs). 2 customers flagged it as "worse than pre-rollout" :rotating_light:
Evan: can you paste a few canonical examples + request ids? need to see if it's an API config issue vs model delta.
Samira: shared minimal repros below (snippets anon'd). also included the customer request_id for logs: r-ccf2a7, r-ccf2b1, r-ccf2d8. sample prompt 1 and outputs:

Prompt: "When was AcmeCorp founded and who was the founder?"
Expected (from baseline): "AcmeCorp was founded in 2007 by Lina Hooper."
Observed (redwood-2.4): "AcmeCorp was founded in 2011 by Marcus D'Souza."

Prompt 2: "List the main features of the X-300 router (model year 2020)."
Observed: mixes specs from X-200 and X-300, lists an extra wireless chip that doesn't exist.

Samira: repro steps I used (curl):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2.4","input":"When was AcmeCorp founded and who was the founder?","temperature":0.2,"max_tokens":120}'
```
Responses reproducible ~9/10 for that model version.
Priya: thanks Samira. first quick questions: were customers pinned to redwood-2.4 or using "latest" alias? any custom system prompts?
Samira: two customers pinned to redwood-2.4, one used latest. none using system prompts except minor role messages.
Evan: @Priya can you run the regression eval across our 500 prompt QA suite vs the 2.3 baseline? prioritize entity/date questions. I also want to check if quantization profile changed during rollout or if we switched kernel selection for that model.
Priya: on it. initial quick diff: accuracy on our factual QA set dropped ~6.8% vs 2.3 for token-level answers; bigger on entity exact-match. spinning up canary eval now, will share top failure samples.
Marco: deploy-bot shows the canary finished and we promoted 2.4 at 2025-11-21T03:12Z, rollout strategy: gradual variant swap, no rollback. we did enable a new faster int8 quant path on nx-gpu-64 pools during rollout.
deploy-bot: Canary completed: 2.4 promoted to stable across eu-west and us-central at 2025-11-21T03:12Z, change-id: deploy-20251121-2.
Evan: that quant path is the prime suspect. Priya, can you reproduce with quantized vs unquantized binary? also check KV cache/attention kernel differences, maybe precision loss on named-entity logits.
Priya: repro notes: running the same prompt against a non-quantized build (dev image) returns baseline answer. running with int8 shows drift. collecting logs, will produce a diff dataset.
Samira: customers are asking for mitigation asap. some asked to pin back to previous model. what's our fastest mitigation?
Alex: (product) short term: offer customers model pin to 2.3 or enable fallback to 2.3 for the alias. CSR playbook: 1) apologize, 2) offer pin/fallback + credit, 3) collect affected prompts + expected answers. I'll draft messages.
Evan: ops action: add emergency routing rule to route requests from impacted customers to redwood-2.3 alias. Priya: stop the int8 runtime on eu-west pool until we validate.
Priya: plan of record: 1) temp disable int8 kernel on eu-west 2) run eval suite on quant vs float 3) compare top N failure deltas and inspect logit distributions for named entities 4) if confirmed, rollback quant change and push hotfix to quant kernels. ETA 3-6 hrs for initial signal.
Samira: I'll coordinate with the customers, collect more examples and confirm they accept immediate pin.
Marco: logging note - request traces show consistent temperature=0.2 across samples; throughput/latency unchanged. so not a prompt mixup.
Evan: also check our canary traffic split — did any legacy routing rules accidentally send production traffic to experimental variant?
Priya: early stat: entity exact-match failures concentrated on proper nouns with high out-of-vocab tokens; logit peak mass shifted between top-1/top-3. attaching (inline) sample diffs in the thread.
Samira: customer quote "the model confidently asserted a wrong founding year for a well-known company" - they escalated to legal/comms. need status updates every 2 hrs.
Alex: I'll prepare external comms template and run legal check. also prep rollback comms if we need to revert.
Evan: good runbook: 1) mitigate (pin/fallback), 2) root cause triage (quant kernels), 3) fix (kernel patch or rollback), 4) regression testing + deploy. keep thread updated.
Priya: posting first batch of failing prompts + dev logs now. will follow up with numeric eval and suggested hotfix. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Samira: thanks team - customers notified of temporary pining option, one accepted pin immediately. keeping this thread live for updates.
